requirements.requirement: Explore the globe without selecting data regions
requirements.evidence: Browser coordinate searches: San Francisco, Seattle, Tokyo, Cape Town and Fiji/date line; regional layers activated and previous regional controls disappeared. Six-continent weather and date-line API checks passed.
Fresh browser reload opened World explorer with all 51 layer checkboxes checked.

19 public motion-capable layers plus three credential-dependent vessel layers. Timestamped transit, aircraft and Finnish AIS verified in source-specific audits. ISS is separately labeled modeled. Current Follow ISS showed moving playback.

World destination markers, local-time cards, fresh activity counts, activity-aware Surprise me, Follow flight/transit/ship/ISS, trails, pause/resume and radar playback are implemented. Browser verified world return, explorer opening, ISS following and pause/resume; prior source audits record flight/transit/ship and radar playback.

requirements.requirement: Do not fake freshness, movement or coverage
requirements.evidence: Date preservation, stale/partial/access labels, model labels, bounded interpolation, no extrapolation, speed/gap rejection and date-line behavior covered by fixtures and inspected browser details. Three optional vessel integrations clearly report access required.

requirements.requirement: Public repository with reproducible local prototype
requirements.evidence: Public HowdyMoto/location-scout repository; setup and dependencies documented in README and scout/requirements.txt; loopback server verified at port 5284.

limits: 51 configured integrated layers includes three optional credential-dependent vessel feeds; these are not live-verified without keys.
Global exploration does not imply complete local transit, dispatch, vessel or sensor coverage in every place.
Aircraft requires regional zoom and receiver coverage; a world view is not a worldwide aircraft census.
Motion uses a 90-second buffer; ISS, weather and air quality are explicitly modeled; historic/dated reports are not current incidents.
Canberra public light-rail endpoint is deprecated but was returning fresh reports.
Public production hosting, commercial data licenses, provider credentials and new city adapters remain follow-up work; no deployment was requested.
